create_llm_client: create an LLM client using LLMClient enum to instantiate AIStudio or mock client
build_reward_model: build a reward model using RewardModel enum to get mock, length-based, or chain-of-thought ranking model
create_statement_model: create a statement model using StatementModel enum to get mock or chain-of-thought statement model
run_rank_aggregation: run rank aggregation using RankAggregation enum to get mock or Schulze social ranking method
test_tie_breaking_method: test the TieBreakingMethod enum and RANKING_MOCK constant from social choice utils
